text:
We're hiring a Backend Engineer.

The team is growing and we need someone to work on our backend in Go and PostgreSQL.

Details:
- Fully remote, working across EU timezones
- €70,000–€95,000 per year
- Go and PostgreSQL
- Three interview rounds, and we try to keep them quick and friendly

It's a good fit if you like designing clean APIs, writing concurrent code that stays easy to follow, and running databases you can rely on. Day to day, you'll work through hard problems and ship code that has a real effect on the product.

We think good engineering comes from people who have the trust and support to do their best work, and we try to run the team that way.

If you're interested, comment here, send us a DM, or apply directly.
